conflict_reader.description: Conflict: terminated by other getUpdates request; make sure that only one bot instance is running

conflict_webhook.description: Conflict: can't use getUpdates method while webhook is active; use deleteWebhook to delete the webhook first

text_empty.description: Bad Request: message text is empty

text_too_long.description: Bad Request: message is too long

caption_too_long.description: Bad Request: message caption is too long

reply_not_found.description: Bad Request: message to be replied not found

react_not_found.description: Bad Request: message to react not found

edit_not_found.description: Bad Request: message to edit not found

cant_be_edited.description: Bad Request: message can't be edited

no_text_to_edit.description: Bad Request: there is no text in the message to edit

no_caption_to_edit.description: Bad Request: there is no caption in the message to edit

not_modified.description: Bad Request: message is not modified: specified new message content and reply markup are exactly the same as a current content and reply markup of the message

delete_not_found.description: Bad Request: message to delete not found

file_too_big.description: Bad Request: file is too big
